summary: Renalin is registered only as a 'multi-herb formula' herbal dietary supplement capsule. The FDA record does not name its herbs.
cautions: Undisclosed herbal composition: neither the patient nor the doctor can check for nephrotoxic herbs, potassium content or interactions with transplant or other drugs.
Ask the patient to bring the package so the ingredient list can be reviewed; stop it if kidney function worsens without another cause.
Registered as a food supplement with no approved therapeutic claims.
bottom_line: No evidence and an undisclosed formula. Advise against it in CKD, dialysis and transplant patients until its full ingredient list has been reviewed.
